scale_cues: Plate is a standard square dinner plate, roughly 25-27 cm across, used as the main scale. Salad occupies about one third of plate width and the rice mound about one third. Chicken pieces are estimated relative to the plate and the rice mound. Bone weight is excluded from the estimates.
assumptions: Plate diameter or width of about 26 cm, typical dinner plate size.
Chicken is bone-in, so bone mass is excluded from edible grams.
Salad greens are mostly lettuce-type leaves, so leafy greens are treated as raw lettuce.
Dressing is light, so it is a small amount and not pooled.
The pale sliced item in the salad is uncertain and could be onion, fennel, or jicama.
Tiny white specks (possibly sesame seeds or crumbled cheese bits) are under 5 g in total and are folded into the salad and cheese estimates.
The pale slice near the rice may be a mushroom or onion and is not separately counted.
